_about: Reviewed reclassifications applied by harness/finalize.mjs on top of the harness verdicts in registry/results/*.json. The harness verdict is kept as `harnessStatus`; every entry states why.

AUTH-012.reason: No logout-all route exists (SessionService.revokeAllForUser is unused). The prior campaign recorded this as NOT_APPLICABLE on an owner decision that is not documented anywhere in the repository; without a documented decision it is an undefined product decision, not proven inapplicability.

CAMPAIGN-03 BUG-NEW-010 warmed car page.reason: The warmed car page stops serving the car at once (BUG-NEW-010-console-timing: not-found document within 0.1 s) but answers HTTP 200, not 404.

BUG-NEW-010 warmed car page survives dea.reason: Superseded by BUG-NEW-010-timing, which measures the same out-of-band suspension instead of sampling once at 65 s: the car page stops serving the car after 71 s and the dealer page after 332 s, inside the design of #251. The 65 s sample is shorter than the page's 60 s ISR window plus one regeneration.

ENQ-LIFE-010.reason: Permission enforcement is proved (STAFF→CLOSED/SPAM 403, unknown status 400), but the scenario asks for invalid transitions to be rejected and the product defines none: OWNER/MANAGER may move an enquiry from any status to any other, including CLOSED → NEW and CONTACTED → NEW (enquiries.service.ts setStatus). Undefined product decision UPD-2.

PUBLIC-015.reason: Experience correct (branded not-found page, noindex, no listing data); the web page answers HTTP 200 rather than 404 — BUG-101, judged under SEO-009.

LISTING-LIFE-015.reason: API 404 and no listing content on the web; the web page's HTTP status is 200 (BUG-101).

STORAGE-005.reason: No page crashes on a missing object; a vehicle card shows a broken image instead of its fallback (BUG-109, judged under MEDIA-012).

NOTIFY-001.reason: Strengthened by NOTIFY-DISC-001: the console mailer emitted 274 dealer.application.received e-mails during the campaign; the outbox → worker path is asynchronous (PERF-DISC-001).

BUG-NEW-010-timing.reason: Out-of-band suspension (no console action): designed cache windows are ≈ 70 s (car, revalidate 60) and ≈ 610 s (dealer, revalidate 600); BUG-111 records the window.
